summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Kharg, a city in Iran that serves as the capital of Kharg District in Bushehr County, Bushehr Province. It reports the 2006 census population and states that the city lies on Kharg Island in the Persian Gulf.
one_line: Kharg is a city on Kharg Island in the Persian Gulf, capital of Kharg District in Bushehr Province, Iran.
key_facts: Kharg is a city in Iran.
Kharg is the capital of Kharg District.
Kharg District is in Bushehr County, Bushehr Province, Iran.
Kharg is also Romanized as Khārk.
At the 2006 census, the city of Kharg had a population of 8,196.
At the 2006 census, the city of Kharg had 1,963 families.
Kharg is located on Kharg Island in the Persian Gulf.
